presets.name: Portrait Photo (Moss)
presets.prompt: A professional portrait photograph: detailed face with realistic skin texture and visible pores, natural window light, catchlights in the eyes, 85mm lens, creamy bokeh background, honest natural expression.

presets.name: Fashion Editorial (Moss)
presets.prompt: High-fashion editorial photograph: couture styling, dramatic studio lighting, elegant pose, detailed fabric textures, Vogue magazine aesthetic, professional model, flawless retouch.

presets.name: Cinematic Still (Moss)
presets.prompt: A cinematic film still: dramatic lighting with strong contrast, anamorphic lens character, film grain, movie color grading with teal and orange tones, carefully staged depth composition, 35mm cinema look.

presets.name: Architecture Photo (Moss)
presets.prompt: Architectural photography: striking building geometry, clean lines and symmetry, blue hour ambient light, glass reflections, wide-angle perspective, minimal composition, architectural digest quality.

presets.name: Food Photo (Moss)
presets.prompt: Editorial food photography: professionally styled dish, soft directional studio light, shallow depth of field with macro texture details, fresh appetizing look, clean plating, magazine quality.

presets.name: Landscape Photo (Moss)
presets.prompt: A breathtaking landscape photograph: dramatic sky, golden hour light, wide-angle composition with layered depth, atmospheric haze in the distance, rich natural colors, National Geographic quality.

presets.name: Product Shot (Moss)
presets.prompt: Commercial product photograph: clean seamless studio background, soft diffused lighting with gentle shadows, reflective surfaces, centered composition, razor-sharp product detail, advertisement quality.

presets.name: Wildlife Photo (Moss)
presets.prompt: Wildlife documentary photograph: telephoto 600mm compression, animal in its natural habitat, razor-sharp fur and feather detail, golden hour light, softly blurred background, National Geographic quality.

presets.name: Street Photo (Moss)
presets.prompt: candid street photography, busy pedestrian crossing, motion blur of passers-by around a sharp subject, shop signs and reflections, overcast daylight, reportage feel

presets.name: Golden Hour (Moss)
presets.prompt: outdoor portrait at golden hour, warm low sun flare from the side, long soft shadows, glowing skin rim light, shallow depth of field, haze in the backlight

presets.name: Night City (Moss)
presets.prompt: night city street portrait, neon signs reflecting on wet asphalt, mixed magenta and cyan light on the subject, dark background with bokeh city lights, moody cinematic feel

presets.name: Studio Portrait (Moss)
presets.prompt: professional studio portrait, softbox key light at 45 degrees, subtle rim light, clean seamless grey backdrop, crisp facial detail, fashion magazine retouch level

presets.name: B&W Film (Moss)
presets.prompt: black and white analog portrait, 35mm ilford hp5 look, visible film grain, deep blacks and soft highlights, natural window light, timeless documentary mood

presets.name: Photo Realism (Moss)
presets.prompt: A candid photograph with natural proportions and honest imperfections: realistic skin texture, natural light, documentary framing, no stylization.
